correctness.rationale: Complete proof: Newton finite-difference interpolation excludes unsupported primes. In the b≥a branch, the explicitly inspected published Lemma 9 gives valuation zero. For b<a, Kummer residue comparisons supply a−min(a,t) low carries plus max(0,t−b) disjoint high carries for every multiplier. The special q=1+p^a(m−p^b), or q=2 when m=1, produces exactly a−b carries and is in range. No finite experiment replaces the proof. The standalone verifier recomputes exhaustive small cases and the construction on a wider range.

value.rationale: D(k) is the natural finite-binomial gcd underlying a 2004 OEIS conjecture resolved in 2026 only as a unit criterion. Determining its full value at every k is a complete natural arithmetic classification, not an arbitrary subcase. The exact p-power heights and minimizing multipliers sharpen the previous local divisibility test and yield D(n−1)=n precisely at prime powers. The same formula answers which exact prime powers survive for every input.
